metadata.title: Electric Blue 80s New Wave Album Cover
useCases: Album art for synth-pop or new wave music

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochromatic blue composition featuring a dynamic, expressive figure in 80s punk attire with layered typography.
excludeWhen: soft pastel color palettes are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, energetic figure with spiky hair and studded clothing is captured in a mid-action pose, bathed in a saturated cyan/blue light. The composition is framed by a white border and features a mix of boxed sans-serif, fluid script, and bold serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochromatic blue wash unifying subject and background
High-contrast lighting emphasizing texture of studs and fur
Dynamic diagonal pose creating tension against a static square frame
Layered typographic hierarchy using contrasting styles
coreInvariants: Saturated cyan-blue color cast across the entire central image area

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure, medium-full shot, filling approximately 70% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's expressive face and spiky hair silhouette.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top logo, follows the diagonal line of the arms down to the side text, and settles on the central figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: White outer border provides a clean frame for the dense, textured blue interior.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cyan-blue monochromatic wash for the image area.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White for the outer border and primary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blues with deep black shadows and bright cyan highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Strictly limited to cyan, white, black, and a single magenta accent.

letterConstructionRules: Top logo uses heavy, wide geometric sans-serif inside a rectangular box
Secondary name uses a fluid, thin-stroke script that overlaps the logo
Body text uses a high-contrast serif with thick vertical strokes and thin horizontals
characterSpecificRedesigns: The script 'y' and 'x' have elongated, expressive tails
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Triadic contrast: heavy block sans-serif, delicate script, and traditional bold serif.
graphicDevices: Rectangular framing box for top text
Circular punch-hole detail in top right

preserve: The boxed logo at the top
The split placement of the serif text
avoid: Modern minimalist sans-serifs for the body text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric weight of the top logo
Provides the necessary serif weight and contrast for the side text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast photo of a person in 80s punk fashion (studded jacket, spiky hair) in a dynamic pose, entirely tinted in a saturated cyan-blue monochromatic wash, framed by a thick white border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a blue boxed sans-serif logo at the top center, a pink script name overlapping it, and bold white serif text split between the left and right middle sections.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly monochromatic blue within the border?
Is the top logo contained within a rectangular box?
Is the serif text placed on both the left and right sides of the subject?

adjustableVariables: Specific text content in the three typographic zones
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos
The exact facial features of the subject

avoid: Default system fonts like Arial or Times New Roman
Soft, blurry edges on the subject

postGenerationChecks: Check that the white border is clean and uniform.
Ensure the pink script is legible against the blue background.
Verify the high-contrast lighting on the clothing textures.
Confirm the typography follows the three-style hierarchy.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochromatic [Color] + [Fashion Style] Portrait + Boxed Logo + Split Serif Typography
